scope: Show excluded eCampus sources within the existing home scope and shared Task row layout, remove their separate legacy page, preserve existing allow-import callback.
coverage_note: 85 related tests passed (home 51, shell/calendar/widget 6, lists 6, eCampus 22). After final excluded-row layout polish, the affected 3 tests passed again with captures and stronger source-date sorting assertions. Counts overlap.
initial_failure_note: The added assertion incorrectly expected allow-import to delete the source row. Existing repository behavior preserves it as unreviewed with taskId=null. The test was corrected; the repository was not changed.

analysis.capture_method: Exact stdout copied from direct flutter analyze --no-pub output

behavior.navigation: Drawer selects the excluded home scope; selected highlighting and existing bottom navigation remain; no extra route or back button.
behavior.layout: Reuse home section and row title/due styling, fully wrapped title, source course subtitle, leading allow-import icon. Remove legacy card, explanatory header, badges and text button.
behavior.dates_filters: All dates; independent of the saved home period/status/priority/tag filters so excluded sources remain visible. Period selection disabled for this scope.
behavior.sort: Reuse five existing choices, temporary for excluded sources only; reset on leaving scope or home tab; no saved setting overwrite. No unsupported Task filters or new instructions.
behavior.action: Reuse _allowExcludedTaskSync. Removes ignored state by existing repository policy (unreviewed source, no Task creation); next import may review it. No completion/edit/delete/swipe handlers for unimported sources.
behavior.failure: Keep source visible and allow retry; prevent duplicate in-flight clicks; retain existing error notification.

limits: In-memory Drift/widget tests and mock eCampus flows; no real school login or Android installation.
